meta.summary: A Discord bot for discovering, exploring, and tracking projects on Modrinth.

project.title: Every project detail, right in Discord
project.description: `/project` brings up downloads, followers, versions, loaders, and categories, with buttons straight to the source, wiki, issues, and Discord.

user.title: Look up any creator
user.description: `/user` shows a profile, badges, and top projects at a glance, so you never have to leave Discord to check who made something.

organization.title: Or the whole team behind it
organization.description: `/organization` does the same for teams, with combined download counts and their most popular projects.

tracking.title: One dashboard for everything you track
tracking.description: `/tracking manage` lets you pause notifications, set the channel and ping role, and track whole authors, so every new project they publish gets picked up automatically.

identify.title: Identify a mod by its file
identify.description: Drop a .jar into `/identify` and get back the exact Modrinth project and version it came from.

options.title: Turn features on or off, per server
options.description: `/options` controls auto-embeds for plain Modrinth links, jar identification in chat, and changelog summaries.

donate.title: Support development, unlock perks
donate.description: Modrinth Scout is free to use. Donating on Ko-fi raises your tracking limits and speeds up update checks.
